{{Quote|To Luke Skywalker, Jedi Master, Jedi academy, Yavin Four; from Chaf'orm'bintrano, Aristocra of the Fifth Ruling Family, Sarvchi.|The recipient and sender of a message by Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano|<ref name="SQ" />}}
'''Sarvchi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sarvchi system/Legends|Sarvchi system]], a part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Path of the Houses]], which connected it to the [[Cioral system/Legends|Cioral]] and [[Copero system/Legends|Copero systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Constituting a part of the core territory of the Chiss Ascendancy, the interstellar state of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Sarvchi was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Chaf family/Legends|Chaf family]], one of the Ascendancy's [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was under Chaf control<ref name="CSWE Chaf" /> and was a neutral world of representation for the non-Chiss species inhabiting the Ascendancy.<ref name="TEA" /> When, around [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'', shortly prior the events of which [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] sends a message addressed to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] of the Chaf family sent a message addressed to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the sender of the communication was styled as "Chaf'orm'bintrano, Aristocra of the Fifth Ruling Family, Sarvchi."<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sarvchi was first mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="SQ" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square F-9.<ref name="TEA" />
